worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.summary: Fire one mystical beam from each eye; the two beams leave the real eye points toward the same aim point and converge at the chosen distance. Each beam hits only the first contact on its line; the point resonates and the second beam grows only when both beams strike the same target. Resonance form is slower but scales; simultaneous form fires both almost at once, quicker, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.0: One beam from each eye, converging on one point
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.1: Resonance only when both beams strike the same target
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.2: Ranged single-target strike with no contact
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.description.0: Each beam deals about %1$s special damage at a range of %2$s blocks and stops at its first contact.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.description.1: The two beams are fired %1$s apart; in resonance form the second gains up to %2$s more power only when both beams strike the same target.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.resonance.on: Resonance form now: the first beam fires, then the second fires after a pause and gains a bonus only when both beams strike the same target; slower, with a longer gap.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.resonance.off: Simultaneous form now: both beams fire almost together, quicker, each settling independently at x0.95 power, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per beam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per beam is %2$s and the resonance bonus rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.2: From level %1$s the power per beam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.preference.re: On (resonance): the first beam fires, then the second fires after a pause and gains a bonus only when both beams strike the same target; the cost is a slower cast (+1 tick windup, longer gap). Off (simultaneous): both beams fire almost together at x0.95 each, quicker, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it will not fire beams and closes in first; a larger value starts the exchange sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the two beams finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to fire beams; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
